final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(appearance_count) AS total_count, AVG(appearance_count) AS avg_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.bats, h.appearance_count, 1.0 * h.appearance_count / t.total_count AS share_of_total, 1.0 * h.appearance_count / t.avg_count AS count_over_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t
